authentication: none; plain HTTP file download from accessgudid.nlm.nih.gov/release_files/download/
cost_notes: free; bandwidth-bound (full release is multiple GB)
entity_identifiers: UNKNOWN - no GMDN code in the release XML that this probe inspected
historical_coverage: full GUDID (5.18M DI records) via the full release; delta files carry only changed records (e.g. 5,548 records in the 2026-11-02 daily delta). GUDID publishes no complete version history of a record, only the change stream
known_limitations: devicePublishDate is the per-record publication clock; publicVersionDate is only a version stamp and must not be substituted for it
delta files are incremental: a point-in-time view requires replaying deltas on top of a full release, and GUDID never publishes the superseded versions themselves
the full release ZIP is far above the 8 MB protocol cap, so only a daily delta was byte-verified here (5,548 records, matching the advertised numberRecordXML)
the release XML is namespaced, so naive '<device>' string matching under-counts records (observed: 0 vs 5,548) - parse the namespace-aware tag or the header count
the download page's advertised MD5 is the only integrity hint; re-verify locally
licence: US federal GUDID data; FDA republishes GUDID under a CC0 1.0 dedication (open.fda.gov/license/, verified). NLM's own release-file terms were not opened in this pass
rate_limits: not documented on the download page; files are static and each is downloaded once
research_value: The only device source that yields a reproducible *snapshot plus change stream*: the daily delta header states the exact change window and creation time, and every record carries devicePublishDate. That makes it possible to reconstruct what GUDID knew on a given date, which no live API can do.
timestamp_fields: header/creationDate (when the release file was generated)
header/period/@start and @end (the change window the delta covers)
devicePublishDate (per record - first publication in GUDID)
publicVersionDate (per record - version stamp, not a publication date)
update_frequency: daily delta, weekly combined, monthly, plus periodic full release
